findings.evidence: application/graph_engineering/application/release_operations.py:1023–1043 require_current validates installed resources, factory identity and frozen projection/schema/digests but never reads the issuing simulator session or current coordinator journal/claim/receipt. Evidence issuance at lines 826–1021 retains only the evidence object in _issued, with no evidence-to-live-authorities binding. Consequently an unchanged evidence object remains admissible after session.close(), target mutation, or terminal action-state drift while installation bytes remain unchanged. CategoryCompletionOracle.issue and require_issued rely on this method at profile_execution.py:1118 and :1254, including TaskApplication.complete_category checks. This contradicts ADR-0009 §5, lines 247–249, requiring live target/action revalidation on issue/use/precommit. Separately, issue_evidence checks factory-issued observation identities and the current target but does not revalidate the terminal coordinator outcome after deployment/health observations were issued; journal/claim/receipt drift between observation and final evidence issuance can therefore go undetected.
findings.required_change: Within the existing foundation scope, retain an opaque process-local binding from issued evidence and deployment observations to their original session, coordinator and outcomes. At final evidence issuance and every require_current/projection/oracle-use/precommit check, require the same live open session, freshly validate exact target/artifact/generation/slots and health, and rebind the terminal outcome to current coordinator journal/claim/receipt. Fail closed on closed, destroyed, foreign or changed live authorities without replaying apply/restore. For partial compensation, preserve the original manual deployment observation as historical receipt-bound evidence; validate the terminal compensated outcome as current rather than incorrectly requiring the superseded manual outcome to remain current. Keep portable restart unsupported and fail-closed.
